assessments.note: UN World Urbanization Prospects 2018; Tokyo led the UN ranking for decades. The 2025 revision (new city definition) puts Jakarta and Dhaka ahead — the wording says "was for decades".

support.quote: As of 2026, the United Nations estimates the total population at 36,954,512, making it the third-most populous urban area in the world.

assessments.note: Confirms the >35 million figure and that Tokyo is no longer first, matching the bank body (past tense wording).
